newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki heaves to another record as Raisio soars.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki heaves to another record as Raisio soars.

text.p: Shares heaved to another record high close on Tuesday, with food group Raisio soaring after it announced a U.S. partnership to market its Benecol cholesterol-cutting agent, brokers said.

The FOX index rose 0.97 percent to a life-high 1,183.63, while the all-share HEX gained 0.22 percent to a record high 3,424.40 points. Volume rose to a hefty 650 million markka, 45 percent of it in Nokia and almost a sixth in Raisio.
But trade was listless ahead of Raisio's news and with the Dow industrials and Nokia's ADR starting softer, brokers said the recent steeply rising trend seemed to be flattening out.
Raisio starred in a broadly sluggish market, putting on almost 30 percent, or 108.00 markka to 478.00 -- its highest since March when it scaled 500 markka -- in heavy volume.

The stock took off after Raisio said it had sealed a deal with Johnson & Johnson's McNeil Consumer Products to sell the active ingredient of its cholesterol-cutting Benecol margarine in a range of products North America.

"This was very good news," one broker said. Others said not all the demand had been satisfied, and Raisio could post further gains although the market would be waiting for further financial details, perhaps from a London briefing on Wednesday.
